pythonova.name: Pythonova
pythonova.notes: Concept, design, sprite, name, type, and dex flavor by Princess-Phoenix This fakemon originates from Princess-Phoenix's 'Project Freemon' on DeviantArt. "It is a very long snake fakemon thanks to the smoke tail, but if the smoke is removed its actual body is hilariously short and front heavy, with its tail tip ending a little beyond where the darker grey tail smoke starts. Like the rest of its line the high heat contained in its body and smoke act as a hot air balloon and allows it to hover in the air or fly around. "
